title: Reindexing assignment weights
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $e$ be a bijection from the $m$ coordinates to the $n$ coordinates, let $b4$ be real, and assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates. Pulling the assignment back along $e$ leaves its product weight unchanged, when each coordinate weight is $b4$ for a free state and $(1-b4)/2$ for either fixed state.
hypotheses_covered: A bijection between the $m$ and $n$ coordinates
A restriction state is assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
